financings_after_balance_sheet.what: February 2026 underwritten public offering of 23,000,000 shares at $5.00 (including the underwriters' option shares)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In February 2026, the Company sold 23,000,000 shares of its common stock in an underwritten public offering at a price of $5.00 per share. and received net proceeds of approximately $107.6 million.
